description_en: Queries the usage duration ranking and details of each end user under a tenant within a specified date range. Aggregates offline statistical data, summarizes connection duration by user dimension, and populates basic information and per-desktop usage duration details for users on the current page
description_zh: 查询租户下各终端用户在指定日期范围内的使用时长排行与明细。聚合离线统计数据，按用户维度汇总连接时长，并为当前页用户填充基本信息和每台桌面的使用时长明细
name: QueryEndUserHistoryUsage

parameters.help_en: The start date of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. The date cannot be earlier than 32 days ago. Default value: yesterday
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd。不能早于32天前，默认为昨天
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. The date cannot be later than yesterday or earlier than StartDate. Default value: yesterday
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd。不能晚于昨天且不能早于StartDate，默认为昨天
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query Active Directory (AD) domain users. If this parameter is set to true, AD domain users are queried. If this parameter is set to false or not specified, convenience account users are queried
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询AD域用户。取值为true时查询AD域用户，取值为false或不传时查询便捷账号用户
parameters.name: is_ad_user

parameters.help_en: The page number. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，取值范围为1~100，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of users that meet the query conditions

UserUsageInfoList.description_en: The list of user usage duration entries on the current page
UserUsageInfoList.description_zh: 当前页用户使用时长列表

Description.description_en: The remarks of the user. This parameter has a value only for convenience account users
Description.description_zh: 用户备注，仅便捷用户有值

DesktopUsageList.description_en: The list of usage duration details for each desktop
DesktopUsageList.description_zh: 各桌面使用时长明细列表

Duration.description_en: The usage duration of the user on the desktop, in seconds
Duration.description_zh: 该用户在该桌面上的使用时长，单位为秒

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the user. For convenience account users, this is the actual nickname. For AD users, this is the display name
DisplayName.description_zh: 用户显示名。便捷用户为真实昵称，AD用户为显示名

Duration.description_en: The total usage duration, in seconds

EndUserName.description_en: The username. For convenience account users, this is the nickname. For AD users, this is the UserPrincipalName
EndUserName.description_zh: 用户名。便捷用户为昵称，AD用户为UserPrincipalName

OrgPathList.description_en: The list of organization paths. For convenience account users, this contains multiple organization paths. For AD users, this is the organizational unit (OU) path
OrgPathList.description_zh: 组织路径列表。便捷用户为多个组织路径，AD用户为OU路径

UserGroupList.description_en: The list of user groups. This parameter has a value only for convenience account users
UserGroupList.description_zh: 用户组列表，仅便捷用户有值
